name: manual_c6fbe4
claim: uv pip install treats a bare directory name with extras as a package name; pass ./dir[extra] so the local tree installs, otherwise a cell can silently skip the consumer and the failure hides in the output tail.

decisions.notes: Two first install cells reported success at the producer step while the consumer and pytest never installed.

rationale: Two first install cells reported success at the producer step while the consumer and pytest never installed.
